hero.eyebrow: Video analysis for ice hockey · runs on your Mac
hero.title2: Routine clips come ready, you focus on what matters.
hero.lead: Add the recorded game. HockeyCut finds goals, power plays and penalty kills, faceoffs, zone entries and D-zone exits and prepares them as short clips. Shots and turnovers come as candidates, and you answer Yes or No. Moments you want to see yourself, like the forecheck, you add yourself. You don't have to rewatch the whole game or keep pausing the video.
hero.meta3: The full game stays on your Mac

how.title1: From recorded game to ready clips.
how.s1t: Add the video, squad and game sheet
how.s1p: Drag the recorded video into the app on your computer. Even a 4K video is converted to 1080p. Then add the squad and the official game sheet.
how.s2p: League games are analysed once on our side. The app downloads that ready analysis and places it on your video in a short time. If a game has no ready analysis and the video is a file on your computer, the analysis runs on your computer (Apple Silicon Mac or 64-bit Windows) and takes longer; you can do other work meanwhile. One period takes about 1.5 hours on an M5 Mac.
how.s3t: The list fills in, you answer Yes or No
how.s3p: Goals, power plays and penalty kills, faceoffs, zone entries and D-zone exits appear in the event list. Shot and turnover candidates play their clip by themselves: answer Yes or No with a click or the keyboard.
how.s4p: Choose the clips you need, add arrows and highlights with the drawing tools, show them to the team and export the report.

pv.l2t: Your answers help train the model
pv.l2p: That is what you give back for the free or $10 plan: your Yes and No answers and short clips of those moments are sent to us to improve our model. They are used only for training and stored encrypted; never sold or published.
pv.l4p: When you first open the app you confirm that you own the video or have the owner's permission, and that the people shown (their guardians, for players under 18) agreed to its use. You are not asked again.
pv.l3p: Players are not identified from their faces. Youth footage gets extra protection.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I still have to tag anything by hand?
faq.a1: Goals and power plays / penalty kills come from the official game sheet and the scoreboard. Faceoffs, zone entries and D-zone exits are listed automatically. Shots and turnovers come as candidates: the clip plays by itself and you answer Yes or No with a click or the keyboard.
faq.a2: The match video is not sent to HockeyCut: it is read straight into your computer from the file on it or from your own Google Drive. League games are analysed once on our side, and the app downloads the ready analysis. If a game has no ready analysis and the video is a file on your computer, the analysis runs on your computer. The Google Drive permission is read-only; Google makes this permission type cover all files in your Drive, and the app reads only the video you select. You can remove the permission in your Google account at any time. What is sent to us are your Yes and No answers and short clips of those moments, to improve our model. They are used only for training and stored encrypted; never sold or published.
faq.a3: A Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). There is no Windows version yet — join the Windows waitlist below and we will tell you when it is ready.
faq.q4: How does it find the events?
faq.a4: Goals and power plays / penalty kills (penalty details included) come from the official game sheet and the scoreboard. Faceoffs with their zone, zone entries and D-zone exits are listed automatically. Shots and turnovers come as candidates that you confirm with Yes or No. Statistics are for the team. Supported leagues are listed under “Which leagues does HockeyCut work with?” below.
faq.q5: How do the Free and Premium plans work?
faq.a5: Free: 2 games. After each game you answer its Yes/No candidates and the next one opens. Premium: $10 per month, 10 games; answering 20 candidates after each game is enough. In return, your answers and short clips are sent to us for model training.
faq.q6: What about youth games and player privacy?
faq.a6: There is no face recognition. For youth games (under 18) and games without a confirmed age category, player names are not stored. Single frames go to an outside AI service (Anthropic, USA) only if you switch on the optional Cloud verification and confirm that guardian consent was obtained for that game.
faq.q7: How long does the analysis take?
faq.a7: A game with a ready analysis is ready in a short time. Without one, a period takes about 1.5 hours on an M5 Mac. The analysis runs by itself, so you can work on something else meanwhile.
